<Picture 2>
硬派白发战将，身穿暗红色皮革长款风衣、黑色内衬与战术皮裤，手持重剑与双枪，周身散发冷冽红黑魔力气浪。

与
<Picture 2>

the camera cuts to

the shot transitions to

<Picture 2>
单手举剑格挡，魔力红光护盾展开，随即甩动红风衣滑步侧移，拔枪极速连射，火舌与剑气在半空接连引爆。
the camera dynamically follows
贴地高速滑移，
<Picture 1>

<Picture 2>

the shot changes to
极速下坠定点特写，
<Picture 2>
反手抽刀上挑震开攻击，
<Picture 1>
空中旋身单手撑地滑退数米，
<Picture 1>
与

同时稳住身形横刃相对，周身烈火与魔能疯狂暴涨，在最强杀意临界点定格。

# 工作流说明 / Workflow Notes

## 需要安装的第三方节点

[🤗 H3 的浅空间放大节点](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

```bash
cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler.git
```

---

## 模型下载与放置

**H3 浅空间放大模型，放置在 `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`**

| 文件名 | 精度 | 大小 | 适用场景 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) | bf16 | ~691 MB | Ampere/Ada 显卡上最快 |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors) | fp16 | ~691 MB | 速度与显存平衡（推荐） |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth) | fp32 | ~1.38 GB | 数值精度最高 |

> 三个文件结构相同，选一个你显卡和 workflow 能承受的精度即可。节点下拉框会自动扫描到它们。

---


### ⚠️ 3D 倍率节点必须配合音视频分离/合并节点

`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` 因为 H3 latent 里同时含视频与音频，不能直接接原始 `latent`：

```
[LTXV分离音视频潜空间]  →  video_latent  →  [Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)]  →  [LTXVConcatAVLatent]
                                                        │ audio_latent（原样传回）
```

即：前接 `LTXV分离音视频潜空间`，只把 `video_latent` 喂给放大节点，放大后由 `LTXVConcatAVLatent` 把 `audio_latent` 合并回去。

> 其余2个节点（Target Resolution / Megapixels）都不会处理音频，直接接 `latent` 即可，无需分离/合并。



# 工作流说明 / Workflow Notes

## ⚠️ 重要：`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D) 节点必须配合音视频分离节点使用

`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` 节点**不能直接接在原始 `latent` 后面**，因为 Minimax H3 的 latent 里同时包含了视频和音频潜空间，直接一起放大可能会破坏音频。

正确连接方式（参考截图）：

```
[av_latent]
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ LTXV分离音视频潜空间     │  ← 把 latent 拆成 video_latent + audio_latent
└─────────────────────────┘
    │ video_latent
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Minimax H3 Latent       │  ← 只放大 video_latent
│ Upscaler (3D)           │
└─────────────────────────┘
    │ latent (已放大)
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ LTXVConcatAVLatent      │  ← 把放大的 video_latent 和原始 audio_latent 合并
└─────────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
[VAE Decode / 后续节点]
```

即：

- **前节点**：`LTXV分离音视频潜空间`（输出 `video_latent` + `audio_latent`）
- **中间**：`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)`，只连接 `video_latent`
- **后节点**：`LTXVConcatAVLatent`，把放大后的 `latent` 和未改动的 `audio_latent` 重新拼回

---

## 节点参数建议

| 参数 | 推荐值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `model_name` | `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors` | 按需选择精度 |
| `scale` | `2.0` | 1.0–4.0，常用 2× |
| `device` | `cuda` | 没有显卡可选 `cpu`，但速度很慢 |
| `precision` | `fp16` | 与模型文件对应；想稳可选 `fp32` |

---

## 完整流程示意

```
H3 低分辨率生成
      │
      ▼
VAE Encode（得到 av_latent）
      │
      ▼
LTXV分离音视频潜空间
      │ video_latent
      ▼
Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)   ← 在这里放大
      │
      ▼
LTXVConcatAVLatent
      │
      ▼
第二阶段二次采样/重绘精修
      │
      ▼
VAE Decode → 高清视频
```

> 这个流程跳过了「VAE 解码 → 像素放大 → 再编码」的笨重往返，也避免了对 latent 直接插值带来的鬼影/重影问题。

| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) | bf16 | ~691 MB | Fastest on Ampere/Ada GPUs |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors) | fp16 | ~691 MB | Balanced speed and VRAM usage (Recommended) |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth) | fp32 | ~1.38 GB | Highest numerical precision |

> All three files share the same architecture—simply pick the precision that your GPU and workflow can handle. The node's dropdown menu will automatically scan and detect them.

---

### ⚠️ 3D Upscale Node Must Be Used with Audio/Video Separate/Concat Nodes

Because the H3 latent contains both video and audio data, `Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` cannot be connected directly to the raw `latent`:

```
[LTXV Separate Audio/Video Latent]  →  video_latent  →  [Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)]  →  [LTXVConcatAVLatent]
                                                                  │ audio_latent (passed through unchanged)
```

In other words: place `LTXV Separate Audio/Video Latent` before it so only `video_latent` is fed to the upscaler node, and then use `LTXVConcatAVLatent` afterward to recombine `audio_latent`.

> The other 2 nodes (Target Resolution / Megapixels) do not process audio, so they can be connected directly to `latent` without separating or concatenating.

# Workflow Notes

## ⚠️ Important: `Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` Node Must Be Used with Audio/Video Separation Node

The `Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` node **cannot be connected directly to the raw `latent`**, because the Minimax H3 latent contains both video and audio latent spaces. Upscaling them together directly may degrade or corrupt the audio.

Correct Connection Flow:

```
[av_latent]
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ LTXV Separate Audio/Video   │  ← Split latent into video_latent + audio_latent
│ Latent                      │
└─────────────────────────────┘
    │ video_latent
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ Minimax H3 Latent           │  ← Upscale video_latent only
│ Upscaler (3D)               │
└─────────────────────────────┘
    │ latent (upscaled)
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ LTXVConcatAVLatent          │  ← Recombine upscaled video_latent and original audio_latent
└─────────────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
[VAE Decode / Downstream Nodes]
```

In short:

- **Preceding Node**: `LTXV Separate Audio/Video Latent` (outputs `video_latent` + `audio_latent`)
- **Middle Node**: `Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)`, connected only to `video_latent`
- **Succeeding Node**: `LTXVConcatAVLatent`, recombines the upscaled `latent` with the unmodified `audio_latent`

---

## Recommended Node Parameters

| Parameter | Recommended Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `model_name` | `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors` | Choose precision based on your needs |
| `scale` | `2.0` | Range: 1.0–4.0, 2× is standard |
| `device` | `cuda` | Select `cpu` if no GPU is available, though it will be very slow |
| `precision` | `fp16` | Matches the model file; use `fp32` for extra stability |

---

## Full Workflow Diagram

```
H3 Low-Resolution Generation
      │
      ▼
VAE Encode (outputs av_latent)
      │
      ▼
LTXV Separate Audio/Video Latent
      │ video_latent
      ▼
Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)   ← Upscaling happens here
      │
      ▼
LTXVConcatAVLatent
      │
      ▼
Stage 2 Second-Pass Sampling / Redraw Refinement
      │
      ▼
VAE Decode → HD Video
```

> This workflow bypasses the cumbersome round-trip of "VAE Decode → Pixel Upscale → VAE Re-encode", while avoiding ghosting and double-image artifacts caused by direct latent interpolation.
